items.goal: Add GET api/catalog/items/{id:int}/brand-mates?count= (versions 1.0 and 2.0, anonymous) to src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs, written like GetItemById. Return 400 ProblemDetails when count is outside 1-12 (default 4) and 404 when no item has that id. Otherwise return the same-brand items, excluding the item itself, ordered by Name with ordinal comparison, taking count, and including CatalogBrand like GetItemById. Rebuild Catalog.API and commit the regenerated Catalog.API.json and Catalog.API_v2.json. In WebApp, add CatalogService.GetBrandMates(int id) (concrete class only) and a 'More from {brand}' section below the item details in src/WebApp/Components/Pages/Item/ItemPage.razor that renders each returned item with the existing CatalogListItem card. Leave the section out entirely when the list is empty. Put its styles in ItemPage.razor.css.

reason: Brand-mates endpoint returns correct ordered same-brand items (default 4, max 12), 400 for count 0/13, 404 for unknown id and [] for a solo brand under v1.0 and v2.0 anonymously; the item page shows 'More from <brand>' with up to 4 CatalogListItem cards linking to other items and omits the section when empty.

items.reason: The 400 response for an out-of-range count is served as application/json rather than application/problem+json as the ProducesResponseType attribute declares (the body is still ProblemDetails).
items.fix: Optionally return TypedResults.Problem(...) or set the content type so the media type matches the declared problem+json.

items.reason: GetBrandMates is awaited together with the item load, so a failure of the secondary brand-mates call (other than 404) fails the whole item page instead of just omitting the section.
items.fix: Consider catching failures of the brand-mates call and treating them as an empty list.
